name: Erisa
source:
A cast member on her trial period.
She tends to act aloof, but is actually a very kind and considerate girl with a tsundere personality.
She has a severe tendency to overthink things, where even the protagonist's casual words or gestures can instantly send her imagination running wild in that direction.

She may seem strong-willed, but she actually loves imagining romantic scenarios and sometimes gets lost in her own fantasy world.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/bunnygarden2/en/]official website[/url]]
